items.mainDefect: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without locking while BuildIndex writes to it, creating a data race.

secondary.defect: Concurrent builds for the same key duplicate index creation and collide on the index directory.

items.mainDefect: Concurrent initialization builds share totalBatchesIndexed without synchronization, creating a counter data race.

secondary.defect: Concurrent builds share the outer err variable without synchronization, creating a race that can return the wrong error.
Build goroutines capture the loop variable info and can build using the wrong iteration's value.
